messages:
maria.cs: Heads-up — AcmeHealth just returned the vendor security questionnaire and attached a DPA change request. They want: (1) SOC2 scope confirmation (prod + backups?), (2) data residency option for embeddings, (3) BYOK for keys, and (4) retention limits for embeddings. Renewal review call is tomorrow 11am PT, need a short summary and ask list for AE.

ev an.security: Can you paste the exact questions they flagged? Need to see whether this is scope clarification vs. new requirement. Also tag me if they want attestations.

maria.cs: Pasted the key excerpts below from the PDF: 
---
Q12: "Does vendor restrict data residency for embeddings or generated outputs? Please list available regions and transfer safeguards."
Q18: "Describe key management options. Does vendor support BYOK or HSM integrations? If yes, detail steps and supported KMS vendors."
Q21: "Maximum retention period for embeddings and any purging mechanisms. Is pseudonymization available?"
---
They also circled: "SOC2 in-scope systems — can you confirm whether backups and logs are in-scope?"

sam.onboard: I can pull their onboarding artifacts and the signed DPA v1. Uploading now to the shared folder and will link. Expect it in ~10m.

compliance-bot: New ticket created: CS-4821 — "AcmeHealth questionnaire triage". Assigned to: maria.cs, evan.security. Due: 2026-05-08.

lena.success: For renewal risk: if they insist on regional-only hosting for embeddings, that is a product+ops change for Hosted customers — that will materially affect pricing and timelines. Flag AE & solutions so we don't over-commit during the call. Could we prepare fallback language (we can offer Dedicated/Private options)?

maria.cs: Good call. Evan — can you confirm current policy: do backups/logs fall under SOC2 scope for our hosted product? If we say yes, we should cite the SOC2 scope doc.

ev an.security: Short answer: our SOC2 covers production systems and customer data stores; backups are included where they contain customer data. Logging aggregation (anonymized telemetry) is excluded unless it contains PII. I'll link the SOC2 scope doc. Also: BYOK is supported for Private and Dedicated with HSM/KMS integrations; Hosted API customers can use envelope encryption for some artifacts but not full BYOK without Private/Dedicated.

sam.onboard: Uploaded: https://drive.company/acme/onboarding/docs (internal link) — contains signed DPA_v1.pdf, onboarding checklist, and previous questionnaire. I also extracted their current agreed retention: "embeddings retained 30 days by default".

maria.cs: Draft reply for the call — please review/edit before I send to the AE to include in the 11am: ```Hi team — quick answers ahead of tomorrow's renewal call: 1) SOC2 scope: production data stores and customer backups that contain customer data are in scope; logs/telemetry are excluded if no PII. 2) Data residency: Hosted API currently operates in multi-region; we can discuss Dedicated/Private options for strict regional residency. 3) BYOK: available for Dedicated/Private (we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and HSM integrations); Hosted customers can use envelope keys for select artifacts — details attached. 4) Retention: default embeddings retention is 30 days; we can propose a BYO retention policy for Dedicated/Private. Please confirm any follow-ups for the 11am call so we can prepare tech contact. Thanks.```

lena.success: That draft looks good. Add a line: "If you require an updated DPA with additional residency or BYOK language, please notify us 21 days before renewal so we can route for legal review."

maria.cs: Added. Evan, can you attach the SOC2 scope doc and the BYOK integration note? If you can't, tell me what to paste.

ev an.security: Attached SOC2_scope_2025.pdf and BYOK_integration_notes.md to ticket CS-4821. Key bullet: AW S/GCP KMS supported for Dedicated; HSM via customer-managed appliance for Private.

sam.onboard: I've also created a short checklist for the AE to use on the call: 1) Confirm whether customer will accept envelope encryption or needs full BYOK; 2) Clarify exact regions for residency; 3) Ask whether retention change is negotiable or a hard req; 4) Escalate to Solutions if Dedicated/Private needed. Sharing checklist in the folder.

maria.cs: Perfect — I'll send the prep note to AE now and close this thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
